author: Unity
description:
Discover what’s next for the Unity Engine across Unity 6.7 LTS and Unity 7—from core architecture overhauls and dynamic rendering to AI acceleration, modern 2D tooling, and team workflows.

Unity 7 bridges the gap between classic authoring and raw data-oriented design with ECS for All, where every GameObject is an entity and ECS transforms are GameObject transforms. Backed by a modernized serialization system, you can add real Entity data straight to GameObjects without giving up familiar Inspector workflows, custom editors, or undo.

In graphics, Unity Studio Productions introduces Atrio, showcasing real-time dynamic global illumination with Surface Cache GI in the Universal Render Pipeline (URP). Experience bounce lighting across dynamic geometry with zero lightmap baking, complemented by Screen Space Reflections, fast Ground Truth Ambient Occlusion (GTAO), AgX tonemapping, and native support for modern runtime upscalers running at full resolution, 60 FPS across mobile and consoles.
title: What’s coming to Unity | Unite Tokyo

author: Unity
description:
We are thrilled to announce that Synty Studios, award-winning publisher of stylized 3D art packs for game developer, is joining Unity 🎨

For over a decade, Synty Studios has empowered indie developers and major studios alike with their distinctive, high-quality stylized 3D art, most notably its popular POLYGON range.

By bringing Synty’s talented artists and founders into the Unity family, we're expanding our foundation of artist-created content for Unity Spark, our upcoming AI-native game creation platform. Synty’s rich asset library will integrate into Unity Spark while remaining fully accessible to developers via the Unity Asset Store.

Please join us in giving a warm welcome to the Synty Studios team!

🔗 Learn more: https://on.unity.com/4zOvIou
title: Synty Studios is joining Unity
